contracts: (A validator whose canonical path is outside the permitted root cannot yield a trusted Replay Result.) AND (Any dependency digest mismatch yields stale and suppresses trusted current Replay Result creation.) AND (Forged version mutation is rejected while the control fixture remains unchanged.) AND (The isolated mutation fixture deterministically reports stale and no current/trusted result.) AND (结构化评估状态为 rejected，原因明确为 NFR-7 范围外。) AND (至少两次相同输入运行产生相同 fail-closed 结果且恒定性断言通过。) AND (验证结果为 rejected，且恒定性检查通过。)
selector_intents: Run the dependency-mutation fixture and fail if freshness remains current or a trusted current Replay Result is emitted.
Run the escape fixture and fail if a validator outside the permitted root is accepted or trusted.
Run the isolated forged-output fixture before the identity hardening; it must fail if forged version text is accepted.
Run the isolated seed-mutation fixture against the pre-fix evaluator; it must fail by accepting or misclassifying the changed seed.
选择 Windows/profile mismatch fixture 验证；若未拒绝或 fixture 非隔离则失败。
选择 fresh-checkout 隔离验证；若重复运行结果不一致或输入漂移则失败。
选择 roadmap fixture 范围守卫验证；若 TC-E0/D2-D6 未被拒绝则失败。
